dimensions.assessment: Authorizes expanded research, clinical trials, and studies on Down syndrome across the lifespan.
dimensions.evidence: carrying out a program of research, training, and investigation related to Down syndrome

dimensions.assessment: Authorizes a federal research program through the NIH without specifying explicit funding authorizations or dollar amounts.
dimensions.evidence: The Director of NIH shall carry out a program of research, training, and investigation related to Down syndrome

dimensions.assessment: Amends Part B of title IV of the Public Health Service Act to establish statutory program elements and reporting mandates.
dimensions.evidence: Part B of title IV of the Public Health Service Act (42 U.S.C. 284 et seq.) is amended by adding at the end the following

dimensions.assessment: Permanent authorization for NIH research activities with recurring biennial reports to Congress.
dimensions.evidence: The Director of NIH shall submit, on a biennial basis, to... Congress... a report that catalogs the research conducted
